## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.47% | 1M: +0.21%) and QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -1.49% | 1M: -4.17%) show tech weakness while XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +9.58%) and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +3.99%) show pockets of strength — two independent confirmations for NEUTRAL.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear moderating: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -6.27%) → falling. Credit mixed: HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +0.01%) and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -1.69%) → flat, keeping a neutral backdrop.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral across rates and FX: yield curve → flat, duration preference → flat, dollar → flat (all indicators show NEUTRAL), leaving policy sensitivity moderate.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +9.58%). Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -5.46%). Style: Value/Cyclicals favored versus Growth given sector breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US mixed: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.47% | 1M: +0.21%) while China strength via FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +3.99%) contrasts with EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -7.70%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Crypto and small caps showing risk appetite: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.98% | 1M: +5.76%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.69% | 1M: +0.32%), while momentum ETFs MTUM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -7.10%) and ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.30% | 1M: -3.11%) show selective speculative flow.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Oil and industrial metals leading: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +15.22%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +12.17%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.57% | 1M: +1.72%). Gold in RECOVERY (GLD 1W: +0.71% | 1M: -3.18%) while Silver SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -10.80%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +9.58%) — clear sector leadership; UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -11.41%) shows natural gas softness.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND) and select EM/China (FXI ABOVE TREND). Divergences: SPY CORRECTION and multiple sector corrections (XBI, CIBR, XLF) point to rotational noise rather than a clean regime shift.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to Energy XLE (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +9.58%) and selective Financials XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +5.11%) showing relative strength; reduce exposure to Tech XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -5.46%) and broad semiconductor names SOXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -13.57%); maintain neutral duration.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +9.58%) if BNO/USO momentum continues. BEARISH: Technology — XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -5.46%) if QQQ weakness persists.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil — USO (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +12.17%) and BNO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +15.22%). BEARISH: Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -11.41%) and Silver SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -10.80%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency/fear pivot), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health threshold), XLK/XLF ratio watch at recent pivot (monitor tech vs financial leadership), SPY 1M performance flip (watch for sustained move above +1% monthly).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, with Energy and Healthcare showing the most consistent strength. Key risk: tech weakness and multiple 1W/1M corrections (SPY, XLF, XBI) signalling rotational noise that could widen if momentum ETFs continue BELOW TREND.
